DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。貯金について、どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need with saving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夫と旅行のための貯金を相談に来ました。私は来年行きたいのですが、夫は毎月の負担を増やしたくないそうで、まだ二人の希望が合っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行時期と毎月の負担で夫婦の希望が合わず貯金を相談したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My husband and I came to discuss saving for a trip. I want to go next year, but he doesn't want to increase our monthly burden, so we haven't agreed on what we want yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you and your husband differ on the timing of the trip and monthly burden and want advice about saving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望を整理するところから伺います。旅行の時期は、もう予約などで決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's begin by clarifying your wishes. Is the trip's timing already fixed by a reservation or anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約はしていません。私が来年を希望しているだけです。夫は、時期を遅らせても無理なく続けたいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約はなく自分は来年希望で夫は時期を遅らせても続けたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: We haven't booked anything. Next year is just my preference. My husband says he'd rather postpone the trip if that lets us keep saving without strain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that there is no booking, you prefer next year, and your husband wants to keep saving comfortably even if the trip is later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期間と毎月使える金額を、ご家庭で一緒に検討する必要がありますね。今日、何かお申込みをされたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll need to consider the saving period and how much you can afford each month together at home. Would you like to apply for anything today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は説明だけにします。私だけで金額を決めて申し込むと、家でまた話が食い違いそうなので、二人で考える項目を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単独で金額を決めず今日は説明だけ受け夫婦で考える項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I'd just like information. If I decide the amount and apply alone, we may disagree again at home, so please tell me what we should consider together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not decide the amount alone, want only information today, and ask what you and your husband should consider together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 旅行に必要な金額、目標の時期、生活費に残す分などを確認しておくと、次のご相談で希望を伝えやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you check the amount needed for the trip, your target date, and what you need to leave for living expenses, it will be easier to explain your wishes at the next consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その項目をメモします。夫は子どもの学用品の支出を心配していると言っています。私の旅行の希望だけでなく、その支出も二人で検討する項目に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夫が学用品の支出を心配していると伝え旅行の希望とともに二人で検討する項目へ入れたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note those items. My husband says he's worried about spending on our child's school supplies. I'd like us to include that spending in what we consider together, alongside my wish to travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your husband is concerned about school-supply costs and you want to include them among the things you both consider along with your travel plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご主人が心配されている学用品の支出も、ご家庭で検討する項目としてメモに残しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also note the school-supply spending your husband is concerned about as something to consider at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。旅行の時期と学用品の支出を家で二人で見直します。今日は申込みをせず、共通の希望がまとまった後で改めて相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旅行時期と学用品の支出を二人で見直し申込みはせず合意後に再相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We'll review the timing of the trip and school-supply spending together at home. I won't apply today; I'll return for advice after we've agreed on what we both want.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will review the trip timing and school-supply costs together, not apply today, and return after agreement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は説明のみとして承りました。ご家庭でお話し合いのうえ、必要でしたらまたご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that today is for information only. Please discuss it at home and come back if you need further advice. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。どんな商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What kind of product are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が塩分の少ない物を希望しています。商品名の「甘口」を見て塩分も少ないと思いましたが、その言葉で比べてよいのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 甘口名から低塩と考え商品比較の方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family wants something with less salt. Seeing 'mild' in the product name made me think it was low in salt too, but I'd like to check whether that term is suitable for comparing products.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to compare products because you assumed the name 'mild' meant low salt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 味の呼び方だけでは、塩分量は判断できません。成分の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can't judge the salt content from the description of the taste alone. Please look at the ingredient information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。甘い味という印象と、塩分の数値は分けて見ます。この二つの表示を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 味印象と塩分数値を分け二品表示比較したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll look at the impression of a sweet taste separately from the salt figures. I'd like to compare the labels on these two products.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate the impression of taste from the salt figures and want to compare the two labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちらも同じ量を基準に比較する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to compare both using the same quantity as the basis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらは百グラム当たりで、もう一方は一食当たりですね。数値の小さい方をそのまま選ばず、基準の量を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 百グラムと一食基準違いを見て数値のみで選ばないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one is per hundred grams, and the other is per serving. I'll check the reference quantity rather than simply choosing the smaller number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you see the difference between per hundred grams and per serving and will not choose by the numbers alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家庭で使う予定の量も考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also consider how much you plan to use at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。一袋使うつもりなので、その袋の量で考えます。小さい数字だけ見てたくさん使ってよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使う袋量で考え小数字だから大量使用可としないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I plan to use a whole packet, so I'll consider the amount in that packet. I won't assume a small number means it's okay to use a lot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consider the packet quantity you will use and not assume a small figure permits heavy use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どの商品にするかは、表示を見てご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consider which product to choose by looking at the labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。甘口という名前で決めず、基準の量と使う量を確認して家族に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名でなく基準使用量を確認して家族へ相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the reference quantity and the amount we'll use, then discuss it with my family rather than deciding based on the name 'mild'.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will check the reference and usage quantities rather than the product name and consult your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりお選びください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there a problem in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人たちに敷物を貸していますが、私は先に帰るので持ち帰りたいです。まだ座っている人がいるため、急に引き抜かず移動の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸した敷物を先帰宅で回収したく利用者を急に動かさず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lent my friends a groundsheet, but I'm leaving first and want to take it home. Some people are still sitting on it, so rather than suddenly pulling it out, I'd like to discuss having them move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to collect the groundsheet you lent because you are leaving first and discuss it without suddenly moving the people using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 皆さんには、持ち帰る予定を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you told everyone you plan to take it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。自分の物だからすぐ片付けてもよいと思いましたが、先に座っている人へ声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未通知で所有物でも先に座る人へ知らせると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought I could put it away immediately because it's mine, but I'll speak to the people sitting on it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you haven't told them and will notify the people sitting there first even though it's yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路へ荷物を広げないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't spread your belongings out across the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。こちらの空いた場所へ一人ずつ移ってもらい、通路を空けたまま敷物をたたみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空地へ一人ずつ移り通路を塞がず畳むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like them to move one by one to this open space so I can fold the groundsheet while keeping the path clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that people will move one at a time to an open space and you will fold it without blocking the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 敷物の上に、忘れ物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is anything left on the groundsheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水筒と小さな袋があります。自分の荷物と決めて一緒に包まず、誰の物か聞いて渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水筒袋を自物とせず持主を確認して渡すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: There's a water bottle and a small bag. Rather than deciding they're mine and wrapping them up with it, I'll ask whose they are and hand them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will check who owns the bottle and bag and return them rather than assuming they're yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 片付けた場所もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the area where you packed up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。持ち主へ物を返し、友人が移ったことを確かめてから敷物を回収します。下にごみが残っていないかも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持主へ返却移動確認後回収し下のごみも見ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll return the items to their owners and check that my friends have moved before collecting the groundsheet. I'll also check that there's no rubbish left underneath.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return belongings, confirm everyone has moved, then collect the groundsheet and check for rubbish underneath.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行先のご案内で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you find your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に聞いた「文化センター」へ行きたいです。ただ、その呼び方だけでは場所が伝わらないようなので、地図で探して説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 略称文化センターでは通じないので画像地図で行先を示したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to go to the 'cultural center' my friend told me about. But that name alone doesn't seem to identify it, so I'd like to find it on a map and explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the shortened name 'cultural center' isn't understood, so you want to show your destination using an image or map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所や正式な施設名の分かる物をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have something showing the address or the official facility name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この招待の画像に名前と住所があります。私が短く呼んでいただけで、画像では「地域交流文化会館」と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 招待画像の正式名と住所を見せ自分が略していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This invitation image has the name and address. I'd just been shortening it; the image says 'Community Exchange Cultural Hall'.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were shortening the name and show the official name and address in the invitation image.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じような呼び方の施設と区別して、画像の住所で位置を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish it from similarly named facilities and check its location using the address in the image.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、普段の呼び方を繰り返すより、正式名と住所を見せます。友人がどの道を歩いたかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正式名住所で区別し友人の経路は未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Instead of repeating my usual name for it, I'll show the official name and address. I haven't asked my friend which route they walked yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will distinguish it by the official name and address and haven't checked your friend's route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図ではこちらの区域です。駅のどちら側へ出るか、案内図と見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: On the map, it's in this area. Compare this with the station guide to check which side of the station to leave from.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画像の住所がこの区域に入ることを確認します。別の文化施設の案内板を見ても、同じ場所だと思って追いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所区域を確かめ他の文化施設の表示を同一とみなさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check that the address in the image falls within this area. Even if I see a sign for another cultural facility, I won't follow it assuming it's the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will verify the address area and not treat a sign for another cultural facility as the same destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 施設の入口など、駅の案内で分からない点は主催者へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: For anything the station information doesn't cover, such as the facility entrance, please ask the organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅を出る方向はこの図で確認します。入口と会場の階は招待を送った友人に聞き、正式名を控えて向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅出口は図で確かめ会場入口階は友人へ聞き正式名を控えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use this diagram to check which direction to leave the station. I'll ask the friend who sent the invitation about the entrance and venue floor, note the official name, and head there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the station exit on the diagram, ask your friend about the venue entrance and floor, and note the official name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 正式名と住所で行先を確認できましたね。入口は主催者へお尋ねください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed the destination by its official name and address. Please ask the organizer about the entrance. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 市の説明会に興味がありますが、当日は仕事です。会場へ行けなくても、聞きたいことを先に出せるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明会当日仕事で欠席だが事前質問が出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm interested in the city's information session, but I'll be working that day. I'd like to know whether I can submit my questions in advance even if I can't attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can submit a question in advance even though work prevents you from attending the information session.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの説明会でしょうか。案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which session is it? Do you have the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この生活環境の説明会です。案内に参加申込の欄がありますが、質問だけ送る欄は見付けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 生活環境の案内に参加欄しか見付けられないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This session about the living environment. The notice has a section to register for attendance, but I can't find anywhere to send just a question.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that on the living-environment session notice you can only find the attendance registration section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当課へ確認しましょう。参加申し込みではなく、質問提出方法の問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the department in charge. You're asking how to submit a question, not applying to attend, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、席の予約はしません。夜間のごみ置場について一つ質問したいので、受け付ける方法があれば教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席は予約せず夜間ごみ置場の質問提出方法を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I won't reserve a seat. I have one question about the rubbish collection area at night, so please tell me if there's a way to submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not reserve a seat and want to know how to submit one question about the rubbish collection area at night.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 回答が個別に来るかも含め、担当課がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The department in charge will explain, including whether you will receive an individual response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。質問を送れば必ず電話で回答されるとは考えていません。後で説明内容を読めるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個別電話回答を前提にせず後日説明資料も読めるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I don't assume submitting a question guarantees a phone response. I'd also like to ask whether I can read what was explained afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can read the information afterward, without assuming an individual phone response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 質問内容と、後日資料の希望を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the staff about your question and your request for materials afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 当日欠席で、夜間の置場について質問一件と後日資料の閲覧希望があるとお伝えください。提出方法を聞いてから送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 欠席と質問一件資料閲覧希望を担当へ伝え方法確認後送ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please tell them I can't attend that day, have one question about the collection area at night, and would like to view the materials afterward. I'll send the question after learning how to submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that staff should be told you cannot attend, have one question and want to view materials, and you will send it after checking the method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 参加予約ではなく質問と資料の問い合わせで承りました。担当課へおつなぎします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've taken this as an inquiry about questions and materials rather than an attendance reservation. I'll connect you with the department in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察で聞きたいことを書いた紙があります。表だけでは足りず裏にも書いたので、裏の質問もあると担当へ知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察質問紙の裏にも記載があり担当へ知らせたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a sheet listing what I want to ask during my consultation. The front wasn't enough, so I wrote on the back too. I'd like to let the staff know there are questions on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to let the staff know your consultation question sheet also has writing on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりする用紙ですか。それとも診察でご自身が見せる物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is this a form for us to take here, or something you will show yourself during the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分で作ったメモです。病院の申込書ではありません。診察で自分が見せるなら、受付では渡さず持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自作質問メモで病院申込書ではなく診察で見せるなら保持すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a note I made myself, not a hospital application form. If I'm to show it during the consultation, I'll keep it rather than hand it in at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is your own question note, not a hospital application form, and you will keep it if you should show it during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の質問メモはお手元に置き、診察で担当へ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep your own question note with you and show it to the staff during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。表に症状の経過、裏に仕事中に困る場面を三つ書きました。裏が追加の経過だと混ざらないよう見出しを付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表は症状経過裏は仕事の困り事三つで見出しを区別すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I wrote the course of my symptoms on the front and three situations that cause difficulties at work on the back. I'll give them headings so the back isn't confused with more symptom history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that the front has symptom history, the back has three work difficulties, and you will distinguish them with headings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察時に両面あることをお伝えください。受付で内容の判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the staff during your consultation that there is writing on both sides. Reception cannot assess the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、二枚の別資料にしたのではなく一枚の両面です。担当に渡す時、裏も見てほしいと自分から言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一枚両面で担当へ渡す際裏面も見るよう本人から伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. It's both sides of one sheet, not two separate documents. When I hand it to the staff, I'll say myself that I'd like them to look at the back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is one double-sided sheet and you will personally ask staff to look at the back when handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お名前が呼ばれるまで、そのメモをお持ちになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the note with you and wait until your name is called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両面の見出しを確認して持って待ちます。診察で表の経過を伝えた後、裏の仕事中の困り事も質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見出しを確認して待ち表経過の後裏の仕事上の困り事を質問すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the headings on both sides and keep it while I wait. After explaining the symptom history on the front, I'll also ask about the work difficulties on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will check the headings while waiting, explain the front's history, then ask about the work difficulties on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身の両面メモとして診察でご提示ください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show your own double-sided note during the consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: なくした電話が届いたと連絡を受けました。今日は仕事で行けないので、家族に代わりに受け取ってもらえるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見付かった紛失電話を仕事中本人の代わりに家族が受取可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told that my lost phone has been handed in. I can't go today because I'm working, so I'd like to check whether a family member can collect it for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether family can collect your found lost phone on your behalf because you are working.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 連絡を受けた方はお客様ご本人ですね。案内された連絡先はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You're the person who received that notification, correct? Do you have the contact details you were given?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、電話を借りて聞いた時に窓口名と番号をメモしました。家族の名前で落とした届出をしたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口名番号を借りた電話でメモし届出本人は自分と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. When I borrowed a phone to ask, I noted the desk name and number. I didn't make the lost-property report under my family member's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noted the desk name and number using a borrowed phone and you yourself are the person who made the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取りの方法や必要な確認は、その窓口へお尋ねください。代理受取りできるとここで確定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask that desk about collection procedures and the necessary checks. We can't confirm here that collection by a representative is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族へすぐ行ってもらわず、先に窓口へ確認します。本人が後日行く方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族を先に向かわせず代理可否と本人後日受取りを確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check with the desk first instead of immediately sending my family member. I'd also like to ask how I can collect it myself on another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will not send family ahead, but will check representative collection and collection by yourself on a later day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人が行く場合も、持ち物と受付時間を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if you go yourself, check what to bring and the opening hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、電話に本人確認用の情報が全部入っているので、画面を見せればよいとは考えず、手元の書類で何が必要か尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認情報が電話内でも画面提示を前提にせず必要書類を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. All my identification information is on the phone, so I won't assume I can simply show the screen. I'll ask which of the documents I have with me are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that even though the identification information is in the phone, you will ask about necessary documents instead of assuming you can show the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取方法が決まるまで、お知らせされた窓口名と番号を保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep the desk name and number you were given until the collection method is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族の受取り可否と必要な書類、本人が行ける時間を聞きます。条件を確認してから誰が行くか決め、家族にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代理条件と書類本人受付時間を聞いて受取人を決め家族へ伝えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask whether family can collect it, what documents are needed, and when I can go myself. After checking the conditions, I'll decide who will go and tell my family too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will ask about representative conditions, documents and your own available collection times, then choose the collector and tell family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 拾得の連絡先へ受取条件をご確認ください。方法が決まってからご家族へお伝えいただけます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the collection conditions with the contact that notified you of the found item. You can tell your family once the method is decided. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the post?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このはがきの宛名を小さく書きすぎました。まだ出していないので、読みやすく直してから送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名が小さく未発送なので読みやすく直したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the address on this postcard too small. I haven't sent it yet, so I'd like to make it easier to read before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to correct the address for readability because it is small and has not yet been sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先は確認できていますか。書き直す部分を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed the destination address? Please show me the part you want to rewrite.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地と部屋番号が重なっています。元の住所はこのメモにありますが、はがきでは四と九が似て見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地部屋が重なり四九が似るが元住所メモはあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The street number and room number overlap. I have the original address in this note, but the four and nine look similar on the postcard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the street and room numbers overlap and four and nine look similar, but you have a note of the original address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正しい住所を確認した上で、はっきり読める形にしてください。作業台はあちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the correct address and make it clearly readable. The writing table is over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メモと一文字ずつ比べます。読みづらい上へさらに書き足すより、新しいはがきへ書き直す方を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メモと比較し書き足しでなく新はがきへ写す方を考えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll compare it with the note character by character. Instead of adding more writing over an already unclear address, I'm thinking of rewriting it on a new postcard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare with the note and are considering copying onto a new postcard rather than adding more writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しいはがきが必要でしたら販売窓口でお求めいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you need a new postcard, you can buy one at the sales counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚買います。今のはがきに本文も書いてあるので、住所だけでなく本文も写してから元の物をしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新はがき一枚を買い住所と本文を写して元をしまうと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll buy one. The current postcard also has the message on it, so I'll copy both the address and the message before putting the original away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will buy one new postcard, copy the address and message, and put the original away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き終えたら、二枚を同時に出さないようお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've finished writing, check that you don't send both postcards together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい方の住所と本文を確認して、その一枚だけ出します。古い方は別に持ち帰り、重ねて投函しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新一枚だけ内容確認後出し旧は別に持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the address and message on the new one and send only that card. I'll take the old one home separately and won't post them stacked together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check and send only the new card and take the old one home separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 販売窓口と作業台をご利用ください。発送前にご確認をお願いします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the sales counter and writing table. Check everything before posting. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から私へ振り込んでもらいます。口座の情報を送るつもりですが、暗証番号まで必要か分からず、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族から振込を受ける情報に暗証番号も必要か先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family is going to transfer money to me. I'm planning to send my account details, but I'm not sure whether my PIN is needed too, so I want to ask first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese first whether the information for receiving a family transfer needs to include your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込先として知らせる情報を確認しましょう。暗証番号は送らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the information to give as the transfer destination. Don't send your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。カードに書かれた数字と、自分で決めた四桁を同じ物だと思っていました。家族にも四桁は伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カードの数字と自分の四桁を混同していたが四桁は伝えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I was treating the numbers printed on the card and my own chosen four digits as the same thing. I won't tell my family the four-digit PIN either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you confused the card numbers with your own four digits but will not share those four digits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行名、支店名、口座の種類や番号、名義など、振込に必要な情報を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain the information needed for a transfer, such as the bank name, branch name, account type and number, and account holder's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要な項目だけメモします。カードの写真を丸ごと送るより、教わった項目を文字で家族へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要項目だけ文字で送りカード全体写真を送らないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note only the required items. Rather than sending a photo of the entire card, I'd like to send my family those items in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will send only the necessary details in text, not a photograph of the whole card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名義の表記も確認してください。入力時の表記はお持ちの口座についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the spelling of the account holder's name too. We'll explain how it should be entered for your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の名前を普段の呼び方で書かず、登録された表記を確認します。番号も一桁ずつ見比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録名義と口座番号を普段呼称でなく正確に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the registered form rather than write my name the way I usually call myself. I'll compare the number digit by digit too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will accurately check the registered holder name and account number rather than use your everyday name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内する情報を控え、送る前にご自身でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Note the information we explain and check it yourself before sending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 振込用の項目と名義を確認して送ります。暗証番号やログイン情報は含めず、家族が入力に迷ったら振込側の窓口へ聞いてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 振込項目だけ送り秘密情報を含めず家族が迷えば振込側窓口へ聞くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check and send the transfer details and holder name. I won't include my PIN or login information, and if my family is unsure how to enter it, I'll ask them to consult the desk at the sending bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will send only transfer details, exclude secret information, and have family ask the sending bank's desk if unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 振込先情報の確認として承りました。担当と口座の表記を確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've taken this as a check of the transfer destination details. Let's confirm the account information's written form with the staff. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: レジに並んでから牛乳を忘れたと気付きました。かごを置いて順番だけ残すのではなく、一度列を抜けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 牛乳を忘れかごで順番確保せず列を抜けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: After joining the checkout queue, I realized I'd forgotten milk. Rather than leave my basket to keep my place, I'd like to leave the queue for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you forgot milk and want to leave the queue without using your basket to hold your place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ商品の会計は始まっていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checkout for your items hasn't started yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、前に二人います。商品は全部かごに入っているので、かごごと持って牛乳の売場へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未会計で前に二人おりかご全体を持ち売場へ戻ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. There are two people ahead of me. All my items are in the basket, so I'll take the whole basket back to the milk section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you haven't checked out, two people are ahead, and you will take the whole basket back to the sales floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列を離れた後は、戻ってから最後尾へお並びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: After leaving the queue, please join the end when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今の位置へ割り込まず、最後尾へ並び直します。連れもいないので、誰かに場所を取ってもらう必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元位置へ割り込まず最後尾へ並び直し場所取り不要と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll queue again at the end instead of cutting back into my current place. I don't have anyone with me, so there's no need for someone to save a place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will not cut back into your original place, will rejoin the end, and don't need anyone to hold a place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 牛乳は奥の冷蔵売場です。ほかに確認したい物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Milk is in the refrigerated section at the back. Is there anything else you need to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかはそろっています。牛乳だけ取って戻りますが、賞味期限を見るため、その場で落ち着いて選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 牛乳だけだが期限を落ち着いて見て選ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have everything else. I'll only get milk, but I'll choose carefully there so I can check the best-before date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that although you only need milk, you will take time to check the date before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お戻りの際は、開いているレジをご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return, please use an open checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かごを持って列を抜けます。牛乳を選んだら、その時の列の最後尾から会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かごと列を離れ牛乳選択後その時の最後尾へ並ぶと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take my basket and leave the queue. Once I've chosen milk, I'll join the end of the queue as it is then to pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will leave the queue with your basket and, after choosing milk, join the end of the queue at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 牛乳売場は奥です。お選びになってからお並びください。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The milk section is at the back. Please choose your milk and then join a queue. Thank you for shopping with us.
